fn count_same_bytes_tail(a: &[u8], b: &[u8], offset: usize) -> usize {
        a.iter()
            .zip(b)
            .skip(offset)
            .take_while(|(a, b)| a == b)
            .count()
    }

pub const fn is_leap_year(year: i32) -> bool {
    (year as i64)
        .unsigned_abs()
        .wrapping_mul(0x4000_0000_28F5_C28F)
        & 0xC000_000F_8000_000F
        <= 0xF_8000_0000
}
